returning_rule: At least two distinct required failed dimensions in path-oracle-corrected prior scores; preserve original split and mark exposed regression.
network_policy: Bounded retry at interrupted request; preserve tools, raw errors and cumulative cost; evaluate recovered delivery separately from network interruptions.
exposure_policy: New families preassigned before execution; after result review they are exposed material, not a fresh blind benchmark.
validation: Partition migration only; original model scores unchanged; all cases exposed.
